records.explanation: Quarry Lane Fitness's most overdue unpaid invoice is 235 days past its due date as of 2026-10-27.
records.sql:
SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(DATE '2026-10-27' - due_date), 0), 0) AS max_days_past_due
FROM intermediate.int_invoices
WHERE customer_name = 'Quarry Lane Fitness'
  AND move_type = 'out_invoice'
  AND amount_open > 0
  AND due_date < DATE '2026-10-27'
